data: Tesla's diluted EPS was $2.04 in fiscal 2024 versus $4.30 in fiscal 2023, a decline of about 52.6% (a drop of $2.26 per share). Net income for fiscal 2024 was $7,153 million, down from $14,974 million in fiscal 2023, and net income attributable to common stockholders was $7,091 million. The 2023 figure was boosted by a $5,001 million income tax benefit, while 2024 carried a $1,837 million tax provision.
